<p class="mono eyebrow">02 — Research · Trade Disruptions and Monetary Policy in Asia</p>

# What Asian central banks are uncertain about

<p class="lede">Policymaker uncertainty indices for ten Asian central banks, read from their own
meeting records, with a trade-policy topic and a hawk–dove stance score. Joint work with Qing Peng
(IMF Shanghai Center).</p>
